text_block_list.text:
Finishing her debut race in brilliant 
fashion, Air Groove returned to the roar 
of the crowd――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Don't let your guard down just 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is only the beginning. Starting 
tomorrow, we stay focused and brace 
ourselves.

And after leaving Sapporo Racecourse, we 
arrived at the airport to return to Tokyo—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...There's still something left for me to 
do. Wait here.

I was a little worried about Air Groove, 
so I decided to watch her from a 
distance...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Senpai! Great job on your debut race!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Um... I just really wanted to tell you in 
person..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Thanks to your support, I was 
able to stay focused and run my best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"The way you ran, Senpai... so 
dignified... so full of confidence... it 
was so cool."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Weren't you nervous, Senpai...? Having 
all that attention on you before the race 
even started...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I was nervous. But that weight exists 
precisely because of the responsibility I 
must fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Responsibility...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the start of the "Empress," I must 
deliver a run worthy of that title. It is 
my responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I saw tension as a sign of where 
responsibility lies. By doing so, I turned 
it into strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Turn tension... into strength...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I have only just finished my debut 
race. The path to my own 'ideal' is a long 
one."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Work as hard as you can toward your 
upcoming debut race as well, Dober. I'll 
be cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! Thank you so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I told you to wait, not to come over 
here.
choice_data_list: I just couldn't leave it alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Fine then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You, too, should now understand anew. The 
weight that I carry.
choice_data_list: I'm always being watched, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And from now on— we will be under 
even greater scrutiny than before.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This doesn't just concern me. ...It 
applies to you as well, my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll say it again. Under no circumstances 
are you to let your guard down. And—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Keep up with me, without fail.

I gave a firm nod back at her words. Our 
journey together has only just begun!
